title: Roadmap events now show on the actual Journey card timeline
changes: The event the Road Ahead bubble reports (e.g. "Picture Matching in 1 lesson") now also shows as a badge on that lesson's own card in the "Your Journey" timeline — the card-based list with Continue/Preview buttons. Previously the event badge only appeared in a separate, less visible compact list, which is why it looked like the bubble and the timeline disagreed.
The addition is purely a small badge inside each future lesson's existing card — no changes to Continue/Preview/retry buttons, card structure, or the timeline's render/scroll logic.

journey.js now exposes window.KaishiJourneyRender so the roadmap engine can ask it to resync after its first computation, the same way it already does for the compact list — so a lesson opened before the roadmap finished loading no longer gets stuck without the badge.
